name: local-cinematic-visual-animation-studio
description: Fully local, visual-only, silent animated-short studio (Remotion + Three.js + Chromium + FFmpeg, with a Canvas2D software fallback)

scripts.render:software: node src/cli/studio.mjs render presets/scripts/bridge.txt --backend software --quality low
scripts.render:chrome: node src/cli/studio.mjs render presets/scripts/bridge.txt --backend chrome --quality high
